title: SKE Crystal Pineapple Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pineapple Ice from SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid blends the tangy, tropical flavour of ripe pineapples with a chilling ice effect, creating a refreshingly sweet and cool vaping experience. This enticing mix is perfect for those hot days or whenever you need a quick tropical escape. Part of the enhanced Crystal Nic Salts collection, this e-liquid is formulated with nicotine salts to provide a smooth throat hit, making it an excellent choice for vapers who need a reliable nicotine fix without the harshness. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures a good balance of flavour and cloud production, suitable for a range of MTL devices. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
